title: Only show discounted price results
desc: Only shows stations with discounts on items

title: Include current system in results
desc: Whether you want search results to include the current system

title: Trading Mode
desc: If ON, when you are docked and set course for a system, will automatically look for best commodity to buy in the target system

title: Minimum hold size for Trading Mode
desc: Suppress Trading Mode checks and announcements if hold size < this number (1-50)

title: Trade Route max distance between markets
desc: The maximum distance allowed between trading systems when generating a Trade Route

title: Maximum distance from star of target market
desc: The maximum distance from the start (in LS) you are prepared to travel to sell goods to a station

title: Starting capital to spend on cargo
desc: The maximum amount you wish to spend to initially fill your hold with cargo

title: Exclude planetary landings
desc: Whether to consider markets where a planetary landing is required

title: Exclude illegal cargo
desc: If ON, will filter out goods that are prohibited at the target station

title: Exclude limpet quantity from available cargo size
desc: If ON, will reduce the amount of tonnage available for hauling cargo by the number of limpets you currently have on board

title: Trade Route : allow loops
desc: Whether to allow revisiting systems already in the Trade Route

title: Trade Route : exclude permit systems
desc: Whether to exclude systems requiring a permit in the Trade Route

title: Exclude stations with market data > x hours old
desc: Will not consider a station for trading recommendations if the last market updated time is too old

title: Maximum number of systems in search result
desc: The max number of systems to include in the new R2R bookmark group

title: Search radius
desc: Distance in LY the plotter will look around for rich systems

title: Maximum distance from star
desc: The maxiumum distance in LS from the star for bodies to be included in the R2R list

title: Use map value instead of scan
desc: If on, will apply the 'minimum map or scan value' threshold below to the Map value of the body, if OFF will apply to the Scan value

title: Minimum map or scan value
desc: The minimum map or scan value to include in search results

title: Make a loop route
desc: Whether route should end up back in your current location

title: Announce next body after mapping
desc: If ON, will tell you the next lucrative body in the system to be scanned, or tell you all done for this system

title: Auto plot to next R2R system when all bodies mapped
desc: If ON, will automatically plot the course to the next system in your R2R route once you have mapped all lucrative bodies in your current R2R system
